job.title: [Post] We're Hiring: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer For An Leading IT Firm ... Looking for…

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise-grade SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot and REST/OCC APIs, with hands-on PIM/ERP/MDM integrations, CI/CD pipelines, Docker/Kubernetes deployments and production support. Proven techno-functional consulting: requirements analysis, user stories, data-flow design and AI-assisted development. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with strong agile teamwork and international stakeholder collaboration.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
cover_en.hook: I am excited by GJ GouthamJayakumar’s focus on cutting-edge SAP Commerce projects. With over five years of end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud delivery at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise that matches your technical needs and growth ambitions.

bullets.label: Platform Design
bullets.text: Designed and implemented core SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) modules—product, catalog and pricing—using Java and Spring, ensuring scalable architecture.

bullets.label: API Integration
bullets.text: Built and exposed OCC REST web services and integrated PIM/ERP/MDM data pipelines (Profisee, DataHub) to synchronize global product catalogs.

bullets.label: Production Excellence
bullets.text: Led CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, optimized SQL queries and provided 24/7 production support, reducing incident resolution time.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Collaborated with international business stakeholders to translate requirements into user stories, functional specs and automated tests.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

tailoring.why_company: GJ GouthamJayakumar is renowned for delivering high-impact SAP Commerce solutions to leading enterprises. Joining a firm that prioritises innovation and complex e-commerce transformations aligns perfectly with my passion for building robust, scalable SAP Commerce platforms and leveraging AI-assisted development to accelerate value for clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to apply my SAP Commerce expertise to help GJ GouthamJayakumar drive innovative e-commerce solutions for its global clients.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years at Rockwell and Shell. I’m eager to bring my Java, Spring and integration experience to GJ GouthamJayakumar. Could we discuss how I can add value?
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will modernize your CCv2 deployment pipelines, extend OCC APIs for new storefronts and streamline PIM-ERP data flows, drawing on proven experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. My hands-on production support will ensure seamless go-live and rapid issue resolution.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
tailoring.email_body: I am Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce Cloud specialist with 5+ years delivering Java-Spring solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am drawn to GJ GouthamJayakumar’s reputation for innovative e-commerce projects and believe my expertise in OCC APIs, PIM/ERP integration and CI/CD pipelines will accelerate your platform goals. I have noted your need for seasoned SAP talent and am ready to contribute immediately. Please find my CV and cover letter attached.
